tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs bde blag rtogs byed ngag 'don zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddha/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gis sgrub ba'i thabs bde blag tu rtogs byed ces bya ba/ rje btsun rin po che dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang / dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang sngon dang mtshungs sku ni sna tshogs zhal ldan zhing / /rten 'brel dag pa'i phyag gis rgyan spras sgeb par ldan/ /rnam mang cha lugs rab brjid dbang phyug dbu ma'i steng / /mnyam par bzhugs pa'i he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i/ /rjes 'jug rje btsun gsung ji bzhin/ /dam pas bskul phyir bri bar bya/ /dbang thob dam tshig sdom ldan zhing / /byang chub sems ldan sngags sbyor shes/ /de yi lam rim mnyam gzhag dang / /spyod lam gtor ma kha zas kyi/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi yis bsdus/ /de la mnyam gzhag la/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi/ bskyed pa la/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed nas mchod pa dang / bzlas pa dngos gzhi yin cing / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs pa dang / ldang ba dang 'khrus bskyed pa'i sngon 'gro yin la/ dag pa dran pa spyod lam gyi skabs su'ang 'jug mod kyi 'dir mnyam gzhag du bsdus so/ /'dir bskyed pa la rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dang po khrig chags su brjod na/ stan bde ba la kha lho phyogs su bstan nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/sangs rgyas la༞ chos la༞ dge 'dun la༞ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu/ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par stims/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas rkang pa'i mthe bong nas 'dzag oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka te no pa tiṣṭha ḍi dho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rokta me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddha mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yā/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa ā hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/

/bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo/ /bshags so/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa/ nyes pa/ ltung ba/ grib ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang bde mchog …lus lhar sgom pa sku'i dga' ba yab yum du gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la lce la bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing / ngag tu shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gi nang du a rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i sems hūm̐ du dmigs pa'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings te …ye shes su byin gyis rlabs pa thugs kyi dga' ba/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bsdus te sngon 'gro/ dge ba thams cad gzhan don du 'gyur pa'i phyir tshangs pa'i gdan bzhi bsgom pa ni/ zhes 'phros shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten khyab/ de nas khams gsum po thams cad khyab/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par byas/ 'od tshur hūm̐ la bsdus te thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ ngag tu su kha bha wan tu/ zhes brjod pas gsung byin gyis brlab/ de'i tshe lus kyi g.yon pa'i sdig mdzub phyogs bcur bskor ba/ sku'i byin brlabs te/ gzhan gsum po la'ang de ltar bya'o/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung ba/ rtsa zhal/ ljang khu byung ba byang zhal/ dmar po byung ba nub zhal/

ser po byung ba lho zhal na 'phros/ phyogs bzhi nas brtsam ste phyogs bcu thams cad du khyab pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral/ bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral/ chags sdang med cing 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la btang snyoms par gyur/ su kha bha wan tu/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/…mig sogs pa la rten khyad par can sgom pas phung khams bskyed mched bzhi sbyang zhing bsgyur ba ni/ sdig mdzub skor ba dang sngags brjod pas phyogs g.yas skor mtshams g.yon skor bya'o/ /slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros lus gang / thogs med nas gsag pa'i sdig sgrib …bdag gi gzhi sbyangs dag 'od phyir 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib dag pas …gzhan gyi gzhi thams cad sbyangs thams cad bde mchog tu gyur …gzhan gyi nga sgyur/ 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas rang gi gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes padma gar dbang / 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dpal he ru ka mig tu gti mug rdo rje/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ kha 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ bskyed mched thams cad dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung khams gar gyi dbang phyug mkha' khams padma can du gyur/…phyag rdor klu sgrub rab byung gi cha lugs/ gzhan rnams g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa/ gru mo kha ṭwāṃ ka rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan par bsam/ bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba ste/ 'di dag a bhi dha na ltar na lha rnams zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom yang / 'dir pham 'thing pa'i bzhed pa bzhin kun spyod kyi lugs ltar nga rgyal tsam dang / mos pa tsam byed gsung /

de dag gi rten khyad par can du byas na tshogs gsog dang po las rgyas pa ni/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros mdun gyi nam mkhar steng du bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po rdo dril 'dzin pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / 'og tu 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bskor ba spyan drangs/…de rnams la phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhes pas bla ma ni/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ…nas/ na maḥshrī tsakra sambha ra …zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams lamaṇḍal bhyaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sambha ra …phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul ba ni maṇḍal tsakra sarba bi ra yo gi ni …zhes pas 'og ma kun la'ang sbyar ro/ /arghaṃ pra titstsha ye swāhā/…mchod yon/ pā tyaṃ pra ti…zhabs bsil tstsha ye swāhā/ badzra puṣpe …me tog hā hūm̐/ badzra dhu pe …bdug spos ā hūm̐/ badzra a lo ke …mar me ā hūm̐/ badzra gandhe …dri chab ā hūm̐/ badzra ṇe wi te …zhal zas ā hūm̐/ badzra shapta …rol mo ā hūm̐/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ji snyed yod pa dang / blos sprul pa'i mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa de las byung ba lta bu nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bsam la lag pa'i sor mo rnams rtse sprad tshigs bar pa bcag rnam par thar pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar gzhag la …na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin brlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin brlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gi 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma gzung pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji rnyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig…ces brjod de phyag rgya dkrol la se gol gdab/ yang snying gar phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta/ a brta hoḥ na ma sa manta buddha naṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ spha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dha tu ā ka sha sa manta mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ri sho dha le maṇḍa le mā ma pra ni te/ puṇye dzñā na ba len/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len dha/ ban dha sasd+ya naṃ ba len na tsa ye swāhā/ bla ma dang …bdag gi lus dang tshogs zhing dpag tu med par sprul/ thog ma med pa nas gsag pa'i sdig pa blo yul du bya ste/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas tshe thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyed pa la rjes su yi rangs pa/ bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis spyan sngar so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do/…sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /de nas bla ma dang gtso bo sangs rgyas dkon mchog sngags chos/ 'khor gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog du mos la/ /bdag dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phangs ma thob kyi bar du sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la༞ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gis 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam tshig dang / sdom pa'i tshogs blang zhing yang dag par rkyang bar bgyi'o/…sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'khor ba ma stong bar gzhan don mdzad pa dang / byang sems lus srog la mi ltos par gzhan don mdzad pa dang / rang sangs rgyas rten 'brel thugs su chud/ nyan thos bden bzhi thugs su chud/

skye bo sbyin pa sna tshogs tsam gtang / tshul khrims sna re tsam rnams bsrungs snyam la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bas skyabs 'gro dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad byang zhing sbyang snyam pas/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / so so skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/…rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /srid mtsho las …/sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /nyan rang rang rang gi myang 'das kyi 'ching ba las/…ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /khams gsum pa rnams sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad la/…dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /byang sems …yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar …sems bskyed pa'o bgyi'o/ /'gro byed pa la chos 'khor bskor dgos pas/…de bzhin gshegs pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa de dag thams cad chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/…chos 'khor bskul bas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/…gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /bdag gi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam rim pa gnyis la gnas par bgyi'o/…lam la gnas par bya'o/ /bdag cag gi de ltar byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phangs myur du thob par gyur cig…ces don dran bzhin pas lan gsum brjod bsngo ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di na legs par gnas pa yin gyis/ gnas pa 'di la gnas na mchog gi go 'phangs thob par 'gyur ro/ /arghaṃ sogs/ badzra muḥ…zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol/ de dag ni tshogs bsags pa dngos dang 'brel ba tshogs so/ snying kha'i hūm̐ …ye shes kyi tshogs bsgom pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba bsrung 'khor bsgom pa la sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar bya ba ni/

las sgo mtshams brgyad khaṇḍa ro ha gnyis dang bcas pa phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu spros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ sdig mdzub g.yon pa phyogs bcur bstan te se gol rtog cing ngag tu/…oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihna grihna hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub dang 'og dus gcig tu/…oṃ grihna pa ya grihna pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a …lhor na ya hoḥbha ga wan badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/…bgegs tshar bcad/ bsrung 'khor brtan par bsgom pa ni/…sa gzhi der raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ me de ni/ sdig mdzub g.yon pa phyogs bcur bskor zhing se gol gdab pa dang bstun te sngags brjod ces pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ phyogs bcur rdo rje nag po gdeng pa'i rwa ba de dag gi phyi rol du mda'i drwa ba mde'u bsnol ba phyir bstan la srid rtse la thug pa phyi rol thams cad skal pa'i me lta bu'i me ri'i bskor bar bsam pa sngags so so lan gsum gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/…badzri bha wa bhadha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra …'phred la song ba'i rgyu ni pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pan dza ra …drwa ba drwa ba'i nang du gyur hūm̐ ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi dā na hūm̐/…dzñu kha/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na larka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ hūm̐ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ khaṇḍa ro ha gnyis dang bcas pa spros/ phyogs bcus gtso byas pa'i bgegs thams cad bkug dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la bkod/ nag phyogs rnams tshar gcad/ phyogs skyong bcu me ri'i nang mda' drwa ba'i 'og gi rdo rje'i 'obs kyi kha khyer la bkod/ hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang tho ba'i tshogs spros pho nya rnams la gtad/

spyi bor phur bus btab tho bas brdungs pas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal byung du phug pas srog dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta yā ghā ta yā/ sarba duṣṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra kī la ya badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnan kā ya/ wāka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mud ka ra badzra kī la ya a ko tra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/…ces brjod pas de dag gi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du thal byung bas bsad pa'i rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du bskyal te ro rnams 'obs kyi nang du skyur bar bsam zhing ngag tu/ gdug pa can thams cad kyi sdig pa dag nas rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig…ces brjod cing spros pa'i pho nya rnams mtshon cha dpag tu med pa thogs rdo rje rwa ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas sgrub pa po sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bsrung bar bsam mo/ pho nya dag las rang 'dra'i sprul pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas spros rdo rje'i rwa ba'i drwa mig nas mi mthun tshogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzhugs par gyur/…sngon la bsrung 'khor bsgom nas/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsag kyang rung / phyi dang nang gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam/ sgyu ma dang mig g.yor lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ sgyu ma'ang mi dmigs pa rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/…dbus su bskyed pa'i rim pa la bzhi'i dang po dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa la/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor sngags kyi byin gyi brlabs pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/

baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab shar shel/ byang gser/ nub padma ra ga lho baiḍūra'i rang bzhin las grub pa gru bzhi pa bang rim bzhi pa cog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus mthing nag de'i steng du paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad par/…phyogs bzhi phyogs mtshon mtshams bzhi mdzes mtshon gzhan gang du/ dbus su/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ri rī/ li lī/ e āai/ o āau/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis g.yon bskor/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/…mos par bya/ de steng du/ kakhagaghang / tsatshadzadzhanya/ ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇa/ tathadadhan/ paphababham/ yaralawa/ shaṣasahakṣa/ ya ra la wa/ ḍadha/ phyag gnyis g.yas bskor dpe byad brgyad bcu'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi ma'i steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nga'o oṃ aḥhūm̐/ yum gyi mkha' dag pa padma/ yab kyi byang sems mtshan pa zla ba/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba mtshon pa hūm̐ rnams rim gyis brtsegs par gyur pa'i oṃ āḥl/ de hūm̐ la/ de padma/ de zla ba/ de hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu/ de khog pa/ de mgo bo/ de thig le/ de nā da la rim pas thims/ nā da dmar skya phra zhing brjid pa/ de ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ 'khyog bzhin pas myur du babs te/…sa sgra zhes bya/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phug nas nyi zla'i bar gyi hūm̐ la thims pa'i rkyen gyis thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo cig car du …'di dag me long gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin dus gcig la wal gyi skyed pa de yang gtso bo nas rim par gsal 'debs par rje pa bzhed kyang /

'dir rten dang brten pa'i dbang du byas nas bla ma dam pa 'phags pa'i lugs bzhin bya/ gsal bar gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang pa …'khor lo so so lha rang rang gi pus mo'i tshad tsam res rim pas mtho ba yin la/ rdo rje rwa ba la sogs pa ni lha'i sked pa tsam sleb pa bkab pa'i dpangs dbu las khru gang tsam gyi mtho ba phubs steng ma steng las 'og ma 'og ma non pas dam tshig 'khor lo'i phubs 'dod yon sa stegs kyi thad non pa tsam ste bris pas bzhin brtsigs pas ya phubs sgo dngos gzhi yin yang ma phubs kyi rtsig pa med pa sgo khang gi steng bkab pa rta bab yin pas ka ba bzhis bteg pa rtsig pa'i ngos bzhi rta bab kyi bar na nam mkha' stong pa dang bcas rtsigs pa bri bya la nag ni rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa nang nas nag dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po'i kha khyer dang / mda' yab las zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa'i drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pas 'phyang ba/ mda' yab kyi steng du rin po che'i drwa ba seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du/ phyogs re re rab tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ bris pa ltar glo bur du gyur pa'i sgo bzhi'i rtsig pa'i steng du cung zad ma reg par ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang / gdugs dang ldan pa/ rnga g.yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / rin po che dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i phyi rol gyi shar …dur khrod bsrung 'khor gyi phyir bsgoms kyang rung gsung gtum drag byang tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/

lho 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ srin po mun pa mi bzad pa/ rlung ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dbang ldan ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ de rnams su rim pa de nyid kyis brgya byin ser po glang po che la gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin ser po rta la gnas pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa be con 'dzin pa/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mchod sbyin dang / dbyu gu gsum pa/ g.yon gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa gri thod 'dzin pa/ rlung lha ljang khu shwa ba la gnas pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan gyi brgyan cing / rang 'dra'i rig mas g.yon nas rten pa'i spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ shi ri shwa a shwad tha/ kaṃ ka la/ tsu ta/ ka ran dza/ la ta par ka ti/ par ti pa ta/ bha dra te shing brgyad/ de dag la rten te sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag tu skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ padma/ hu lun ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / pad chen te klu brgyad/ sgra grags/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po/ 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sprul pa'i dpa' bo/ rnal 'byor ma grub pa/ rigs 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre/ srin po/ gnon sbyin/ sha za/ ro langs/ 'byung po/ lce spyang la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i lha rnams/ shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rim pa bzhi mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa'i dbyibs ltar steng nas steng ma lha so so'i pus mo re tsam gyis je mthor gyur pa'i 'khor lo rnam bzhi sngon po'i steng na rtsibs cung zad mtho bar gyur pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog

'byung ba bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam thar bzhi/ phrin las bzhi dag pas zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas sku mdog sngon po/ khams gsum la gzigs shing dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs zlog thugs su chud cing / 'pho ba bcu gnyis dag pas phyag bcu gnyis pa/ stong nyid snying rje dag pas rdo rje …ye shes lnga ro gcig pas rdo rje stong nyid seṅge sgra sgrogs pas dril bu zhes rje pa gsung / dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dang po gnyis thabs shes zung du chud pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rmongs pas glang po dral bas phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon mgo bo g.yas su bstan te rgyang nas gyon pa/ mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra sgrogs pa'i g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/…sangs rgyas rnams 'dus pas/ nyes pa thams cad spyod pas bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ dngos po dang dngos med kyis rnam rtog gcod pas lnga pa na gri gug srid gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pas/ drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/…bsgreng ba/ bde chen byang sems dang ldan pas g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ka bde ba chen po skyong bas bzhi pa na khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes sems can gyi rgyud pa 'ching bas lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gti mug spangs pas drug pa na tshangs mgo …rje pa rnam rtog rnams 'joms pas gsung drang srong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi khams la bzhugs pa dag pas zhabs g.yas brkyang bas myang 'das kyi mtha' dus mtshan dmar mo shin tu rid pa gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du mnan pa/ shes rab chen pos bdag gnyis su mi 'dzin pa dag pa'i zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha bub du mnan pa/

tshogs rdzogs pas ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcing pa'i rtser/ dgos 'dod thams cad stsol bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/ byang sems gong nas gong du 'phel bas g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba/ phrin las sna tshogs kyis 'gro don mdzad pas mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rgyas pas dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ log par lta ba 'joms pas zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ bdud bzhi 'joms pas mche ba gtsigs pa/ rna rgyan bzod pa/ mgul rgyan dang do shal sbyin pa/ gdub bu tshul khrims/ ska rag brtson 'grus/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsam gtan/ thal chen gyi rgya dang mchod phyir thogs shes rab ste rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bdud 'joms pa la dpa' zhing gzung 'dzin spangs pas stag gi spags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rgyas shing 'gro ba nyon mongs pas gzir ba rnams rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pas/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi gdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sems can la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar mo chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis pa/ gdug pa thams cad 'dul bas g.yon pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba gzung ste yab la 'khyud pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad tshar gcod pas g.yas pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub kyis phyogs bcur sdigs pa/ kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol bas skra grol ba/ nyon mongs kyi sgrib g.yog dang dral bas gcer bu/ spyan gsum pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/

rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ thabs dang mi 'bral bas byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ snang ba dang / thabs dang / lhag mthong dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa shes rab/ zhi gnas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing / zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po rgyas pas khrag gsol ba la dgyes shing / yum gyi bha ga las khrag 'dzag pa bdud thams cad bsreg pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du la ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro ha dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ tshad med bzhi dag pa'i phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pas/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pas mtshan pa ste/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo gri gug gi rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub can/ rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mdzes parabyas pa/ de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'i thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po rdo rje'i rwa ba ka ba/ gdung thog phub dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar pu li ra ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang dza lan dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub u ṭi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me go ta ba rir sū ra bai ri dang rtan pa'i blo can ma/ srin po rwa mi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang me'u thung ma/ rlung de bi ko ḍar rdo rje'i 'od dang lam ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan ma ra war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/

thugs kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po sa bla sbyong ba mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po padma'i rwa ba/ ka ba/ gdung / thog phub dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar ka ma ru par/ aṃ ku ri dang e ra wa ti/ byang o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ko sa lār rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma/ me ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de wi/ srin po laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung kan rtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo sku mdog dmar po sa steng sbyongs pa la spyod pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'i sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po 'khor lo'i rwa ba/ ka ba/ gdung / thog phub dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro ha/ nub sau raṣṭar rta mgrin dang shon ḍi ni/ lho su warṇa dhi bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ srin po sin dhur padma gar gyi dbang phyag dang stobs chen mo/ rlung ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ dbang ldan ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po sa 'og sbyongs pas 'og nas spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa kha ṭwāṃ ka …pham mthing pas bzhed pa bzhin g.yon gnyis par thod pa/

gru mo kha ṭwāṃ ka sgom la/ bri dus skyus bzhin byed pa yin gsung / 'dzin pa/ cha lugs bzhugs tshul thams cad bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs bzhugs tshul thams cad rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa/ de'i phyir rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ka ba/ gdung thog phub dang bcas pa'i shar sgor kha gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong pa ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje bstan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ srin por gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang / dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ zhal dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu/ shin tu drag mo 'bar ba'i gzugs can/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad khros pa'i nyams can/ sku bde ba chen po yongs su gang ba/ dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng bas rgyan cing / sprul pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ lha snam gyi grwa brgyad du/ sman dang bcud sna tshogs dang bdud rtsis gang zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spud pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa rgyan gyi brgyan pa ste/ rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang / bdag gi blo la snang ba'i …dngos grub gugs pas myur ba rten gyi dkyil 'khor pho nya sngags skyes kyi brten 'di nyid 'dzam bu'i …gang zag sogs tha mal pas 'khor lo'i rtsibs re re ltar ro/ /'og min gyi longs sku dang / chos kyi sku'i lha re re nas ngag tu brjod/ yid kyi bsre ba dang /

'bring gi 'khor lo re re nas brjod de bsre bar gsungs kyang / 'dir blo mchog gi dbang du byas nas dus gcig tu/ bsre bar bya ste/ gling na bzhugs pa'i pho nya zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku'i gnas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa yin zhing / de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku pho nya lhan skyes kyi gnas 'og min gyi zhing khams yin la de nyid chos kyi sku las gzhan ma yin/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i rten pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis po 'di nyid mdzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi ngo bo yin zhing / de nyid 'og min gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bo …lhan skyes yin la/ de nyid sku'i …chos kyi ngo bo/ lam dus su sngags skyes ma zhugs nas zhing skyes dang lhan skyes la zhen pa byas pas/ de dag gi bsgrub pa'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam bsgom pa la gom pas rtogs pa yas 'char zhes pa yin no/…bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha so bdun po 'di nyid/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun yang / lha so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag de dag las lus rjes dran mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba rjes dran lā ma/ chos rjes dran khaṇḍa ro ha/ sems rjes dran gzugs can ma/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ dad pa'i dbang po sū ra be ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po rdo rje 'od dang lam ka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/

shes rab kyi dbang po aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ dad pa'i stobs rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de wi/ shes rab kyi stobs rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ting 'dzin yang dag byang chub yan lag 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub yan lag mig mi bzang dang kha ga na/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub yan lag stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyang pa yang dag byang chub yan lag rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro hi/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub yan lag rta mgrin dang sho ḍi ni/ dran pa yang dag byang chub yan lag nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub yan lag he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ yang dag pa'i lta ba padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' kha gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo/ dge chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa ya ma da ti/ dge chos skyes pa bsrung ba gshin rje pho nya ma/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa gshin rje 'jom ma/…lha bu skyes bsu zhen na yang dag par na mkha' 'gro ma lus rjes dran zhes sogs tshur dag dang / phar phyin theg pa sman pa'am/ logs pa lta bur go na lus dran ḍa ki ma zhes phar dag tu sbyar/ de gnyis kar ma gom na 'di dag brjod mi dgos gsung yang /

phyag len la cis kyang mdzad/ 'dir yang dag spang bzhi 'jug tu smos pa lha'i go rim 'khrug pa dang he ru ka 'jug tu smos pa 'phags lam yan lag brgyad mi 'khrugs par bya ba'i phyir/ zhar byung rdzogs rim dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas pas tshul sku lam du byed pa'o/ /'og rlung bskyod pa …lus kyi dkyil 'khor sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa longs sku lam tu byed pa ni/ lte ba'i aṃ …yar 'phul ba'i tshul dang / steng rlung gis spyi bo'i haṃ bskul …mar 'phul ba'i sgra/ dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs …sgra tshul gnyis snying khar 'dres pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa cig car gsal bar gyur pa/ dpral ba/ ltag pa/ rna ba gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshig ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ klad pa zla ba/ klad rgya nyi ma/ bar gyi haṃ yig rdor sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐/ lus 'doms gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rshung rgyu ba sgo bzhi rkang brgyad/ ka ba brgyad/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ snying gi nang gi hūm̐ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i ko rlon mgo g.yas su bstan nas gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa dgra satwa/ lnga pa gri gug drug pa mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pas kha ṭwāṃ ka bzhi pas khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ kha sbub tu mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcing pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ g.yon du tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i yang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub phyogs bcur sdigs pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kun tu kha sbyor zhing khrag gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso bo phyag g.yas …mngon brjod du/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje la/ lā ma ni dril bu la/ dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma ni glang po che'i lpags pa 'dzin pa'i khu tshur dag la/ kha gdong pa ni rtse gsum la/ 'ug gdong ma dang lcags kyu ma khyi gdong ma ni gri gug la/ gshin rje rtan ma ni thod pa na kha ṭwāṃ ka la/ pho nya ma ni shuugs pa la/ mche ba ma ni tshangs pa'i mgo bo la/ 'jom ma ni dgra satwa la/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gnod na zhal bzhi'i ngo bo la'o zhes pa dang mthun no/ dang po dang gnyis pa la mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma/ g.yon gnyis la khaṇḍa ro ha dang gzugs can ma/ g.yas 'og ma bzhi kha gdong /

'ug gdong / khyi gdong / phag gdong / g.yon 'og ma bzhi la gshin rje rtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'jom ma/ thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum/ phyag g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu skra grol bas g.yas brkyangs pas gnas pa/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas su log pa'i yig ge'i dbyibs su gnas pa yul de dang der mos pa bya zhing / rtse mo'i rnal 'byor ma dang / de'i nang gi khams dpa' bo yin pas gnas de dag tu lha yab yum de dag me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin thugs ka'i gtso bo la zhal gzigs par bsgom te/ snying ga yan chad kyis lha 'og dang man chad kyis lha ste/ bar ma rgal thad kar gcig dang …spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ pu dza u a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku/ khams dang bcas pa rnams dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams su gyur pa/ spyi bo pū li ra ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dza lan dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas u ḍ-i ya ṇar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa ar bu ltar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon go ta wa rir sū ra be ri dang rtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin dbus ra mi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de bi ko ḍar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa/ mchan khung gnyis ka ma ru par aṃ ku ri dang e ra wa ti/ nu ma gnyis o twer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing /

kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de bi/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo te tshan dho/ snying kan rtsir 'jigs byed chen po rta sna ma/ 'doms par hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na te nye ba'i tshan dho/ gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po sa la spyod pa/ mtshan ma pre ta pū rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshangs lam gri ba de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro ha ste 'du ba/ rla gnyis sau raṣṭa rta mgrin dang shon ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su barṇa dhi bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sin dhur padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ thams cad khros pa'i nyams can sku bde ba chen pos gang ba/ dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng pas brgyan zhing sprul pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/…rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lus dkyil bskyed pa'o/ /de ltar sgom pa'i bdag nyid phyi nang gi sku'i 'khor lo gnyis dang / sprul pa …'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa ste sku'i 'khor lo bzhi …'og min na bzhugs pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dang / de bzhin du gsung dang / thugs kyi 'khor lo bzhi dpa' bo nyer lnga rnal 'byor ma so bdun thams cad kyang sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/

oṃ …sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs te āḥhūm̐/ sku'i 'khor lo dran pas oṃ/ gsung bzhi āḥ thugs bzhi hūm̐ḥ rten dang brten pa thams cad dran pas sarba bi ra yo gi ni sku bzhi dbyer med du bsgom te kā ya/ gsung bzhi wake thugs bzhi tsitta gnyis su med cing dbyer med pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin de nyid bdag yin mnyam pas sngags lhag ma lan gsum brjod/…sarba bi ra yo gi ni kā ya waka tsitta/ badzra swa bhā ba atma ko3haṃ/ de thams cad stong pa nyid rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rnam par dag oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharmā badzra shuddhoo3haṃ/…dngos po thams cad lha'i rang bzhin yin de dang bdag gi lus ngag tha mi dad/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dag pa chos thams cad kyang brjod pa dang bral ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dag go /zhes dran par byas la sngags lan gsum/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar …nā ro pas sngon la ye shes bzhugs pa mdzad kyang / rgyud las/ de nas go cha gnyis shes nas ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom zhes pa dang / lū hi pas rjes su 'brang nas brjod/ yan lag dang po dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pas te bsnyen pa'o/ /sngon la go cha gnyis bkod kyang chog gsung pa bzhin 'phags pas mdzad pa'i lugs bzhin byas te gnas rnams su zla ba la yi ge so so bsgom de'i lha'i ngo bor mos pa bya zhing / oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bo na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hū dmar po padma gar dbang / phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ḍa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog ste/ dpa' bo dang lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar hāṃ yaṃ sngon po gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ mo dkar mo rmongs ma/ mgo la hriṃ hriṃ ser po skyod byed ma/

spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsan ḍi ka ste yig 'bru thams cad zla ba la gnas pa/ yab …kyi yig ge rnams kyi gnas su yum …yig gnas su dang yum …yig rnams kyi gyi gnas su yab …kyi yi ge gnyis su med pa/ yan lag gnyis pa nye bar bsgrub pa'o/…phaiṃ …mdzub mo gnyis 'dud/ gung mo gnyis dang mthe bo gnyis so sor sbyar lhag ma rnams 'bar ba'i tshul du byas pas dpral bar bzhag pa g.yon du bsgyur rkang g.yon g.yas pas mnan te ngag tu/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las …lcags kyu lta bu 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs/ na mo sogs/ dzaḥnye bar byon/ hūm̐ gi rten dang brten pa so so la thim/ baṃ gi chu la chu bzhin du 'dres/ hoḥrdo rje ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin mnyam du ngag tu/…dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a yog shuddha sarba dharma yo …rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang 'khyud tshul byas te/ chos thams cad ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag de ni yan lag gsum pa bsgrub pa'o/ ga shuddha3 haṃ/ pheṃ/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs/ na mo sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du …zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyi phyag nas ye shes kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas spyi bor dbang bskur/ de dag las sprul pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang / bkra shis kyi glu dang bgegs bskrod pa rnams kyis nam mkha' gang bar bsam pa ni ngag tu/ gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/

/de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ye shes kyi chus lus gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bcu drug…thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa rigs bdag du gyur pa ni/ bde chen dkyil 'khor gyi lha lnga dang / dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang …dbang gi lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs par bsgoms sam/ bdag la sku la gang bde ba thugs gsung par na yan lag bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ste bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa'o// mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ na mo …sngags mchod ni/ bha ga wa te/ bī ri shwa ya sogs …thog mar yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ sumbha ni ḍa ki ni sogs rdo rje nas spel ba/ yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags spel nas bzlos shing / de'i dus su lha rnams gsal btab pa'i bsam pa'i bzlas te sngags rnams rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇḍal sarba bi ra yo gi ni arghaṃ sogs/ gtor ma gnyis sam gang 'byor pa bshams la byin rlabs lhan cig byas pas kyang yong / 'di dang gtor ma byang shar gyi dur khrod du skyed gsungs te chang la sogs pas sbyangs/…oṃ suṃ bha sogs/…sogs kyis bgegs gsal/ oṃ swa bha wa/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ a las zla ba'i steng du dbus/ byang shar/ nub/ lhor/ go ku da ha na las/ ba glang / khyi/ glang po che/ rta/ 'di rnams cung zad 'khrugs par snang yang nā ro pa'i bzhed pa 'di nyid yin pas gong gsal ltar 'di bzhin mdzad gsung …mi'i sha/ de dag gi steng du/ bi mu shu ma ra las/ dri chen dri chu byang sems/

sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ rakta/ de dag gi steng du/ hūm̐ bhruṃ khaṃ dzrīṃ aṃ/ chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ bya ba grub pa/ so sor rtog pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ de'i steng du mtho gang tsam/…oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros rlung g.yos/ me 'bar ba las rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ oṃ dang hūm̐ dang zla ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ thod pa la thod pa/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim/ sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa rnams kyang thod par lhung bas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ…lan gsum g.yon pa'i mthe bong srin lag gis gtor zhing sngags de'i gang ba'i thor ba re re bya la/ gzhi'i thod pa de gshin rje 'joms phul bar bshad/ hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru sogs/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍa ki ni sogs/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ pū dza u a/ go ra de ma/ ka e tri ko ka la ka hi pre gri sau pū na si ma ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha na ma hi swā hā hūm̐/…yid 'byung gi mchod pa/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ ha yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/…ces chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams la dbul te nang mchod/ oṃ hrī ha …bdag gi lce la bdud rtsi myangs pas phyi nang gi lha thams cad tshims nas dgyes pas lha thams cad kyis kyang yig bdun zlos par bsam zhing /

lus kyi snying khar rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul byas nas sngags rang gi ngag tu brjod de mnyes mchod pa'o/ ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs/ na mo bha ga wa te/ wi ri shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nas kheṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa …rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod de bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de rnams kyis bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la mchod pa'o/ kyi bar rang …rje pas 'dir bzlas pa man kyang da lan bzlas pa spyod lam gyi yan lag tu byas nas thog mar rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom la rdor sems bsdu thig le bsdu yi ge bsdu/ bsdu ba rnam pa gsum mdzad kyang 'dir dang po rtsa ba'i ye sngags dang yan lag gi dpe du mas mtshon pa sgom zhing gi lte bar padma 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros nang dang phyi'i he ru ka yab yum 'khor lo nang ma nas rim pa bzhin je gsal je gsal du gyur pas dkyil 'khor 'khor dang / khams gsum pa'i snod bcud thams cad shin tu gsal bar byas pas/ de thams cad cung zad g.yo ba dang bcas pa/…phrig phrig par ni dpe dang po khab len gyi lcags g.yo ba lta bu/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas snod bcud bsrung 'khor la/ de dur khrod/ de gzhal yas khang / de dam tshig 'khor lo/ de sku/ de gsung / de thugs/ de snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ de gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/…bsdu ste dpe gnyis lji bas dngul chu bsdud pa lta bu'o/ /'bring bsdu ba gnyis la phyi'i dkyil 'khor med pas khams gsum lus la bsdu ba nyid do// de zhal gcig phyag gnyis par …ni dpe gsum rus rbal yan lag bskum pa lta bu/ bsdu/ de'i yum yab/

yab lte ba'i rdor sems yab yum/ de'i yang yum yab/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐/ de yang / mas rim gyis thig le la thim/…par bsam pa dpe bzhi pa gar sprin la thim pa lta bu/ thig le de yang je phra je phrar gyur nas mi dmigs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngang la yid mnyam par gzhag de'i …dag pa dran pa mnyam gzhag tu 'du ba'i dbang du byas nas 'dir brjod pa yin la/ 'di dag ngag tu brjod pa'i tshe ma dag pa'i khams dang rgyan cha la sogs pa de dag lha dang sngags de dang de'i ngo bo yin mnyam du mos pa byas la lha dang sngags kyi rnam par bsgom mi dgos gsungs te/ de ni dpe lnga pa lan tshwa chu la thim pa lta bu'o/ /yan lag gi dpe ni ngo bo nyid kyi steng du dbab te gong gi spros pa de rnams cha lugs 'od zer ri rgyangs pa lta bu yin bsam gyi mi khyab pa'o/ /ngo bor gar mkhan dngos sam nyi ma'i rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba yin pas de rnams ngo bo nyid kyi steng du chu la chu gzhag pa'am/ mar la mar gzhag pa lta bu ste/ yan lag gi dpe du mas mtshon pa yin no/ /'di ni bskyed rim gyi rjes la cis kyang bsgom sgom pas 'dir bris la/ gzhan gnyis bskyed rim gyi bzlos la ces kyang rdzogs rim ma yin pa 'dir ma bris so/ /ngang la skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka yab yum du dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs te/ so dang sen mo khaṇḍa ka pā la/ skra dang ba spu ma hā kaṃ ka la/ lpags pa dang dri ma kaṃ ka la/ sha mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ rtsa rgyus pū ra wi ri/ rus pa 'od dpag med/ mkhal ma rdo rje'i 'od/ snying rdo rje'i sku/ mig aṃ ku ri/ khris pa rdo rje ral pa can/ glo ba dpa' bo chen po/ rgyu ma rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ mnye ma rab tu bzang po/…lto ba rdo rje bzang po/ sgang pa 'jigs byed chen po/ 'doms bar mig mi bzang / bad skan stobs po che/

rnag rin chen rdo rje/ khrag rta mgrin/ rngul nam mkha'i snying po/ tshil dpal he ru ka mchi ma padma gar dbang / mchil ma rnam par snang mdzad/ snabs rdo rje sems dpa'/ so dang sen mo oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ skra dang ba spu oṃ ku ru ku ru/ lpags pa dang dri ma oṃ bhan dha bhan dha/ sha oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ rtsa rgyus oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ rus pa oṃ hrāoṃ hrāoṃ/ mkhal ma oṃ hra hra/ snying oṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ mig oṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'khris pa oṃ da ha da ha/ glo ba oṃ pa tsa pa tsa/ rgyu ma oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ mnye ma grihna grihna/ lto ba oṃ a kad ṭa a kad ṭa/ sgang pa oṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ 'doms bar oṃ dzñoṃ dzñoṃ/ bad kan oṃ ྄྄kṣa maṃ kṣa maṃ/ rnag oṃ haṃ haṃ/ khrag oṃ hīṃ hīṃ/ rngul oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tshil oṃ ki li ki li/ mchi ma oṃ si li si li/ mchil ma oṃ hi li hi li/ snabs oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bi ri shwa ya sogs/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo oṃ ha/ rna rgyan na ma hi/ mgul rgyan swā hā hūm̐/ gdub bu drug bau ṣa ḍa he/ ska rags hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs phaṭa haṃ/ mgul rgyan oṃ na mo bha …nus na rgyan re re la rtsa sngags re re ma nus na spyi la tshar gcig brjod 'og ma'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// ga wa te badzra bā ra hi sogs/ mgo bo'i do shal shrī badzra he he ru ru sogs/…ces rnal 'byor ma'i sngags bdun po/ rna rgyan oṃ hriḥha sogs/ glang lpags dang stag lpags/ oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki ni sogs/ ska rags oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ sogs/ phyag gi thod pa oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki sogs/ ya ma mi tha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbu rgyan gyi thod pa de'ang bcom ldan 'das kyi dag pa zin pa'i rjes kho na la yum la sogs pa lha thams cad kyis dag pa'ang de bzhin no mnyam du dran par bya'o/…oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa'i ngo bor rnam par dag la/ kha ṭwāṃ ka ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo …dang sgrub pobacom ldan rdo rje can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad/…bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng lha'i sku mdog lta bu byung /…ces dran par byas te mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan zin to/ 'phags pa mchod grub na 'di bzhin mdzad gsungs/…yab kyi zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ padma nas thon rdo rje'i lam nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shrī de shā ya/ mahā kal pa aghi sanni bhā ya/ dzā ḍā mu ku ṭaka ṭo ya/ daṃṣṭa kā ra lo gra bhi ṣa na yu khā ya/ sahā pra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ pā ra shu pā sho tya ta shu la kha ṭwāṃ ka dha ri ni/ bhya grā dzi na ambha ra dha rā ya/ mahā dhumpā andha ka ra wa pū ṣa ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bhan dha bhan dha/ trā sa ya/ trā sa ya/ kṣo bha ya/ kṣo bha ya/ hroṃ hroṃ/ hra hra/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da hā da hā/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ ba sa tu dhi ra/ ant+ra mī la a ba lambhi ni/ grihna grihna/ sapta pā ta ma ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ ba bā ta dza ya/ ta sā ya/ a ka ṭa dha/ ā ka ṭa dha/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzñoṃ dzñoṃ/ kṣ+maṃ kṣ+maṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha wa ti badzra wā ra hi baṃ/ ārya a pa rā dzi ti tre lo kya mā te ma hā bīdye shwa ri sarba bhu ta bha ya sha he mahā badzri badzra/ ā pa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri nai bhra ma ṇ-i/ sho ṣa ni/ ro ṣa ni/ kro dha/ ka rā le trā sa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ pra bhe dha ni/ a pa rā dza ye/ bhi dza ye/ dzambha na/ stambha ni/ mo ha ni/

badzra bā ra hi/ mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri khaṃ ge/ tadyathā/ pro ta ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na prā nān/ kiṃ ki naṃ/ khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badzra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya/ sho ṣa ya/ badzra kha ṭwāṃ ga ka pa la dha ri ni/ ma hā pi si ta mān pā sha ni/ ma nu ṣya anḍa prā bri te/ san ni dhyaṃ na ra si ra mā la gran thi twa dhā ri ṇi/ sumbha ni sumbhe/ ha na ha na/ prā ṇān/ sarba pā shu pā nan/ mahā man satstshe dha ni/ kro dha mūr dhe/ daṃṣṭa kā rā li ni mahā mu dre shrī he ru ka de ba sya a gra ma hi shi sa ha pra shi re/ sa ha pra bā ha be sha ta sa ha pra ā na ne/ dzwa li taṃ te/ dza sye/ dzwa la mu khi/ piṃ ga la lo tsa ni badzra sha ri re/ badzra a sa ne/ mi li te/ ni mi li te/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu tsaṃ mu tsaṃ/ a dwe te mahā yo gi ni/ pa thi ta siddhi/ dreṃ dheṃ dreṃ dheṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me/ ha sa ha sa/ bhi re/ hā hā/ ho ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kya bi nā sa ni/ sha ta sa hā pra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta/ pa ri wa re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sing hā ru pe khaḥ gā dza tū pe gaḥ trai lo kya a dha ri/ sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī ra a dwe te hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha/ mahā pa shu mo hā ni/ mahā yo gi sho ri stoṃ/ ḍā ki ni/ sarba/ lo kā naṃ/ bhan dha ni/ sa tya pra tya ya kā ri ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhu ta trā sa ni/ ma hā bi re pā ra ma sid dhye/ yo gi shwa ri snying po' snying po yum gyi rtsa sngags/…phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa …snying po swāhā/ oṃ sarba bhud dha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa …snying po swāhā/ oṃ tsau rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki ne ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ la me ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇu re he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru paṇḍi pāe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'o/…oṃ pra tsaṇḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇṇa kṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban dha ban dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha wa tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya hā nā se ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ra ma ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kharbā rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hra hra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dru matstsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/…thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i sngags/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ai rā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da hā da hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhe ra wī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa tu dhi da ant+ra mā lā a ba lambi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bakṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihna grihna sapta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃb ṣa ba tas dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shya ma de bī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kaṭa ṭa a kaṭa ṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha tre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya karṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzñoṃ dzñoṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khī gā …gsung gi 'khor lone ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣaṃ kṣaṃ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra we ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hiṃ hiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇḍi ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pā le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā …sku'i 'khor lo'i sngags phreng 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams kyi snying po'o/

bhirye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu kā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā ka sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shu ka rā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma da ḍi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma du tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi ne ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/…sgo mtshams pa brgyad kyi'o/ /oṃ yā ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di dag zhi ba la sngags phreng mdog dkar po gcig ting la gcig 'brang pa mda'i shugs kyi 'gro ba/ rgya so so la bungs kyed nas sgro'i chun po lta bur 'gro ba/ dbang la dmar po gcig la gcig 'khyud nas 'gro ba lcags sgrog sgrel ba lta bu/ drag po la nag po yab yum gyi sngags sgril ba srad bu lta bu'i 'gro ba'i tshul gyis bzla/ mchog bsgrub pa la rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ go cha gnyis te rin chen bzhir grags pa gang mos gnyis su med par bzlo la/ 'khor gyi sngags zung 'jug la ci rigs pa re re bzlos pa yin no/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la/ gtso bo bdun gyi snying po khri phrag gsum gsum dang rnal 'byor ma gcig gnyis la lnga stong lnga brgya re 'khor lo gsum gyi sngags khri phrag gnyis gnyis bzlas pa'o/…oṃ suṃbha/ swa bha wa/…dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba/ arghaṃ sogs/ oṃ āḥ…zhes brjod pas phyag rgya so so dang bcas pas byin gyi brlab bo/ /mdun bskyed ni mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na re/ hūm̐/ oṃ sumbha/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa/ suṃ las ri rab/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/

ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po/ nyi ma'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma/ zla ba/ hūm̐ de rnams rim gyis hūm̐ gi steng gi na da la thim/ des nyi ma phug hūm̐ la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las skad cig gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pas 'phyang ba/ mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba/ stegs bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo bcu drug mchod rdzas du ma thogs pas mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i rtsig pa'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags dang bcas pa dang / rnga g.yab dang / rin po che dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / gos dang / 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ shing brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sprul pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ grub pa/ rig 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre/ srin po/ gnod sbyin/ sha za/ ro langs/ 'byung po/ lce spyang la sogs pa du mas bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rim pa gsum pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon mgo bo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/

bzhi pas dgra satwa/ lnga pas gri gug drug pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pas kha ṭwāṃ ka bzhi pas khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mos gri thod 'dzin pa gan rgyal dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha sbub du mnan nas/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ g.yon du tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshog mar sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ gar gyis nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub kyis phyogs bcur sdigs pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kun du kha sbyor zhing khrag gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro ha dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ka zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas mtshan pa/

de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar du khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang du ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ mer pū ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ srin por 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rlung du rdo rje'i 'od dang lāṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thams cad sku mdog sngon po/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar du aṃ ku ri dang e ra wa ti/ byang du rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mer rab tu bzang po shya ma de wi/ srin por rdo rje bzang po shin tu bzang mo/ rlung du 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ dbang ldan du mig mi bzang dang kha ga na te/ thams cad sku mdog dmar po/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro ha/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sho ḍi ni/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mer dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ srin por padma gar gyis dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rlung du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad sku mdog dkar po/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo lta bu/ dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso mo lta bu/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/

lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje rtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser/ srin por gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang / dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ rgyan cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu drag mo'i 'bar ba'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad khros pa'i nyams can sku bde bas gang ba/ dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ lha snam gyi grwar sman bcud sna tshogs kyis gang zhing lha rdzas kyis gos kyis 'gul pa bcing pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad kyi brgyan pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa/ snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can/ phyi nang gi sku'i 'khor lo gnyis sogs rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan …pa'i bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed sngags …rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar ba thams cad la 'dre mchod/ phyi mchod/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra rā ṇī ta/ saṃ pra rā ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ne pra dzñā pa ra mi tā/ nā dā swa bhā we ta badzra dharmā hri da ya/ santo ṣa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ a khaṃ …phyi mchod/ swāhā/ oṃ bī ni …ces pa'i snying kha'i hūm̐ las pi wang ma sngon mo rtsa phyag gnyis pi wang sbreng pa phyung dpag tu med pa sprul nas dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam pa kun la shes par bya/ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sambha ra maṇḍal tsakra sarba bi ra yo gi ni/ bī ni badzri ni badzra pu dzi ti …pad skor sngon du 'gro bas lag pa gnyis pi wang sbreng tshul pad kor thams cad la shes par bya'o/ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bāṃ sya badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…gling bu ma ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis gling bu rdung pa phyung / rtsa phyag gnyis gling bu 'bud tshul/ baṃ sya badzri ni badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/

oṃ mri taṃ ka badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…rnga zlum ma dmar mo rtsa phyag gnyis rnga zlum rdung tshul/ mri ta ga badzri ni pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu rdza rnga rdung pa phyung /…oṃ mus dza badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ mus dza badzri …lag pa gnyis g.yas g.yon rdza rnga rdung tshul bya/ ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha sye badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…bzhad pa dmar mo bzhad pa'i phyag rgya kha 'gram du bzhag ha sya badzri ni badzra pū dza te …rdo rje khu tshur skor nas kha 'gram du bzhag āḥhūm̐/ oṃ la sye …sgeg mo sngon po sgegs pa'i tshul byas pa/ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ oṃ la sye badzri ni badzra pū dza te …rdo rje dril bu sku gnyis su mgo g.yon du 'dud pa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gi ti badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…glu ma dmar po ting shags 'dzin pa/ gi ti badzri ni badzra pū …ting shags rdungs pa'i tshul gyis/ dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nir ti badzri ni hūm̐ …gar ma ljang gu gar bsgyur bas āḥ nir ti badzri ni badzra pū dzi te …gar gyi tshul bya zhing āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ …me tog ma dkar mo me tog 'thor ba badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ/ pūṣpaṃ badzri ni badzra pū dzi te …me tog 'thor ba'i tshul bya ste āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhu pe badzri ni hūm̐ …bdug spos ma ser mos āḥ dhū pe badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhi pe badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…mar me ma dmar po sgron me 'dzin pa/ dī paṃ badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥ…rdo rje khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis bshibs te bsgreng ba hūm̐/ oṃ gan dhaṃ badzri ni hūm̐ …dri ma ljang khu dri'i snod 'dzin pas āḥ gan dhaṃ badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…bldu mo bshibs te kha phyir bstan pa dri byugs tshul bya/ oṃ a ……khu tshur g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo sgreng ba kha phyir bstan te dar sha ru pa badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ ā dar sha ru pa badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo ro'i snod 'dzin la …oṃ ra sa badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ

rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du bstan ba bshibs pas/…rā sa badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ parsha badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…reg rdo rje ma sna tshogs 'dzin pas/ parsha badzri ni badzra pū dzi te …rdo rje khu tshur kha phyir bstan nas gos 'dzin tshul bya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ…chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung 'dzin pa/ dharma dhā tu badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…lha mo bcu drug po 'di dag thams cad rtsa phyag gnyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa g.yas 'og mas rdo rje g.yon 'og mas dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul thal mo rgyab sbyar sor mo rnams bsnol/ mthe bong gnyis bcug pa 'khor lo'i tshul/…bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…thal mo sbyar ba'i mtheb mdzub rtse sprad pa/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa ti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mos gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo mnan/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin zhing / /yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ mahā ha ta ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…rdo rje sdam pa las mthe bong gnyis gung mo gnyis mthe chung gnyis rnams so sor sbyar te rkyang ba/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ba ngan par rab gsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab gzhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog

/hasti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…lag g.yon gyi mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag de'i sor mo zham glang sna ltar byas te bkug pa/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol ste/ rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bsgrod par shog /tu raṅga a shwa €rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyar ba'i mthe bo gnyis gung mo gnyis srin lag gnyis rnams sbyar te bya/ ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyis rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /'jigs bral mchog ni thob par shog /lag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon phub 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/…khaḍga ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa'o/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ bdug pa'i tshul …/bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya …rū pa kā ma gu na badzri pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /rol mo bya …shapta ka ma gu ṇa badzri pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas tsandan sbrul snying dang / /a dkar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /gan dha kā ma gu ṇa badzri pū te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pas/ /lus sems ltas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /rā sa kā ma gu na badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam gnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /nam bza' 'bul ba'i tshul bya/…parshā kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/…'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas te phyi mchod/ nang mchod 'bul lugs gong bzhin las/ mdun gyi sbyang ba'i bdud rtsi'i thod pa de la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa chad de/

gtso bo nas gzung nas/ dur khrod chen po rnams kyi bar thams cad kyi phyag g.yon par thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba re phul par bsam …rdo rje 'chang chen rang bzhin sku/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun gdung sel zhing / /bdag blo'i ku mu ta byed pa'i/ /rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan slob dpon sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub ri khrod mgon po dang / /lū hi pa dang dha ri ka /ghaṇa dha ka tsa dza la dhar/ /karṇa pa dang gu hya pa/ /an dhar pa dang te lo pa/ /nā ro pa dang phaṃ 'thing pa/ /blo gros grags pa sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun thugs rje chen po can/ /gan pa sos ston ston pa dang / /chos rgyal chos srin rin rgyal zhabs/ /rab mchod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag thob pa rnams dang / sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i mdo gzhung 'brel pa thob pa'i dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis༞ dkon mchog gsum mkhas zhing grub pa mnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyis༞ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis༞ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong gi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bka' sdod bsrung ma rnams kyis༞ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro/ gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyis༞ rgya dkar/ rgya nag li yul/ bal po la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi rten dang gtsug lag khang gis༞

bod kyi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyis༞ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa'i gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyis༞ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis༞ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig…ces brjod de nang mchod/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ …mnyes mchod de bzhin phaṭa/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shwa ya sogs/ kā me shwa re khaṃ …ces pa'i rkang gnyis dang spro na/ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing / /raṃ raṃ rnam 'khor utpal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gza'i/ /rdo rje dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ka bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan/ /tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod paṇa can/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ha ha zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pa/ /mi yi seṅge dregs pa 'jom mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing / /a la la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad/ /cang te'u sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug dag gi lpags pa bsnams/ /thugs rje cher sprul rab 'khros dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing / /lakṣiṃ go ri zhabs kyis mnon cing ku tsa rab tu bzhugs/ /lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can/ /lha rnams kun kyi 'khor gyis 'khor los yongs bskor mdzad pa po/ /hu lu hu lu dziṃ dziṃ draṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyis/

/phreng ba 'dzin zhing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khro ba yis/ /klu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad cing / /rdo rje chen po ma mā kis ni sku lus rnam par rgyan/ /dud khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyis 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad/ /ka ha ka'i bzhad sgras gnod sbyin tshogs rnams skrag rengs mdzad/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bi bi sha nas sku lus brgyan/ /bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni/ /ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭa kyi mdzad pa can/ /stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyis sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro/ /phyin ci log zhen ltas ngan mtha' dag ma lus med mdzad cing / /gu lu gu lu dziṃ dziṃ yaṃ yaṃ gis ni zhi bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin/ /bde ba chen pos khyod ni maṃ maṃ zhes ni mdzad pa can/ /sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa por/ /ā li ka lis rab tu sbyor ba'i sdom pa gsang ba can/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yis/ /dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa 'di bsgom phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka'i gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/…ces pa'am chos dbyings rnam dag sogs kyis bstod pa ni bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs la/ 'di mdun bskyed phyi'i dkyil 'khor rnams la bsdus pa'i dbang du byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus tshar ba'i 'bring phyi'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis sam rigs pas bskyed la/…rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dur khrod brgyad la phog pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du gyur/ phaiṃ/…sngar bzhin/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi 'khor lo cha dgu spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor so so dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ yo …rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba byas brtan par bya/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung pa'i rdo rje dkar po sbu gu can hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa byin rlabs nang mchod ltar byas pa'i gtor ma las thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba lha thams cad kyi phyag g.yon par phul ba la gsol bar bsam zhing / lag pa rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye la ngag tu/ ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ badzra ḍa ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃḥ dri shya hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum brjod de/ dang pos bde chen 'khor lo dgu'am/ gnyis pas thugs kyi 'khor lo/ gsum pas phyag gi 'khor lo/ bzhi pas sku'i 'khor lo/ lnga pas dam tshig gsum 'khor lo dgu'am/ bcus phul bas mnyes shing tshim par bsam/ grub na ka ra ka ra sogs kyang brjod gsung /……oṃ āḥhūm̐/ arghaṃ sogs oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ na ma bha ga wa te sogs/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig gtor ma gcig las med na de nyid kyi lhag ma mchod/ gnyis yod na'ang byin rlabs dus gcig tu byas la/ rang gi chos skyong la'ang de nyid kyi phud kyis mchod/ de nas 'jig rten pa spyi la 'bul ba las mgron spyan drangs pa ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/…skabs 'dir rang rang gi chos skyong la gtor ma chog ga bzhin dbul/ oṃ badzra ā ra li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ tri shya hoḥ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i bzhugs pa'i dud khrod brgyad spyan drangs/ dud khrod brgyad la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ ud ma ta/ a pa smā ra/ ḍa ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ/ bha liṃ grihna tu/
