sa ma ya rakṣan tu/ ma mā sarba sidhi me pra yatstshan tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣṭaṃ/ bha dza tha/ dzi ga tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar ta ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shud dhe swāhā/ yi ka bha wan tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /kla yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yis/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu gter mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin brlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /bsrung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams rgyas zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ/

arya nutpan na tod oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul/ bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ lag pa'i mthil du padma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ dbus dmar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang / g.yas pas gri gug tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu/ g.yon pas thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ka zhags pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis haṃ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭa phaṭa tsan ḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang dril bu/ gru mo kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ drug ka gcer bu g.yon brkyang pas gnas pa/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus dang / sen mo zla ba'i gdan la/ mthe bor oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dbus dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas rdo rje ḍā ma ru/ mgo bo/ g.yon dril bu/ thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ mdzub mor na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gung mor swā hā hūm̐ padma gar gi dbang phyug dmar mo padma 'dzin pa/ srin lag la bo ṣaḍa he dpal he ru nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ mthe'u chung ngu hūm̐ hūm̐ ho rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser rin po che 'dzin pa/ bsdus pa'i dbus su phaṭa haṃ rta mchog ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lnga ka'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas sngar gyi phyag mtshan/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pas thod pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bakṣa swāhā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa thams cad tshim par gyur cig bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs 'byung zhing / /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i padma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /srid pa gsum par sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang sngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog /arghaṃ sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi ri shwa sogs/ badzra sa satwa sa ma sogs/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badzra muḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃḥho/ oṃ yo ga shuddho sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3 haṃ/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs/ aṃ ha sogs/ pū dza sogs/ nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdor sems bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim gyis ngang la nyal/ tho rang ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sngags su grags pas gnyid slang nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gyur/ ldang ba la sogs dga' ba gsum rjes su dran pa gong bzhin bya'o/ /spyod lam thams cad du bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha dang dkyil 'khor/ brjod pa grags pa'i sgra thams cad sngags/ rtogs pa thams cad ye shes kyi 'du 'phror byin gyis brlabs nas/ yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad nas/ snang ba lha'i rnam pa/ rang bzhin stong pa/ gnyis ka zung 'jug tu shes pa'i sgo nas spyod lam thams cad du bya ste rgyas par bsgom tshul lo/
